Retired Principal Arrested for Threatening BJP MLA

A retired principal has been arrested for allegedly sending a threatening letter to a BJP MLA from Karnal. The letter reportedly contained explicit threats, including being shot with an AK-47. Police have taken the accused into custody and secured a four-day remand for further investigation. The motive behind the threat is currently under investigation.
